documented_deviation.cause: The checkpoint's embedded model_config.yaml sets loss_encoded and loss_time to nemo.collections.audio.losses.MSELoss and nemo.collections.audio.losses.MAELoss. In nemo-toolkit 2.7.3 both classes live in nemo.collections.audio.losses.audio, so an unmodified restore_from aborts before any weight tensor is read, with 'Instantiation of unsafe target ... is blocked'.
documented_deviation.handling: The adapter reads the embedded config from the archive in memory and rewrites exactly those two _target_ strings before calling restore_from. The archive on disk is never modified, the embedded config digest is pinned, and the remap count is asserted to be exactly 2.
documented_deviation.what_is_not_changed: encoder, estimator, noise_schedule, sampler, every weight tensor, model weights load path and strict=True. No other checkpoint or model is loaded.
documented_deviation.impact_on_measurement: Training-only loss objects are not used during inference. Sampler process=ode and num_steps=10 are set after restore, and the sampler class is asserted to be SBSampler.

runtime: Python 3.12.14, torch 2.14.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, actual device recorded per run; one fresh restore and ODE sampler per sample
execution: 16 kHz mono [1,1,T] in, 16 kHz mono [1,1,T] out, seed 1729, num_steps 10, no length compensation required
